# Apocalypse of Peter — Chapter 15
**Agent:** PNEUMA (Dynamic)
**Source:** Akhmim Fragment / Ethiopic MS, Apocalypse of Peter 15

---

*[THE TRANSFIGURATION. Moses and Elijah. The cloud of glory.]*

1. I said to the Lord: "Lord — I want to see the ones who never sinned. I want to know them."

2. "Very well," the Lord said. "Let us go to the mountain and pray."

3. We went. We prayed. And as we prayed, two men appeared — standing facing east, in the presence of the Lord.

4. I could not look at their faces. The light from their faces was too great. Their faces burned like the sun; their clothing shone with a radiance I have no language for. They were dressed in white linen.

5. I was terrified when I saw them. The Lord said to me: "These are your righteous brothers. These are your fathers — those who have received eternal life."

6. I pressed him: "But Lord — the world hasn't ended yet. How are they already with you? And where has their flesh gone?"

7. He said: "I will show you what I showed you once before. Come — bring it, that I may see."

8. Then — suddenly — two men appeared from the east again. Their light was immense, more brilliant than the sun. Their garments were extraordinary — indescribable.

9. I could not look at them. The light was too much. And from them came a voice: like lightning. Like thunder.

10. I said to one of them: "Who are you?"

11. "I am Moses," he said. "The lawgiver. And the one beside me is Elijah the prophet."

12. They entered the cloud. And I and the others who were with me saw the form of the Lord — and the brightness of his glory.

---
*PNEUMA note: This is the APE's version of the Transfiguration, more fully narrated than the canonical accounts. Moses introduces himself — the lawgiver, the one who received the torah — and Elijah stands beside him. Together they represent the law and the prophets, both present at the threshold of glory. The cloud descends as in Sinai.*
